review_notes:
I read the whole file and the related CKS definitions: sphereCone, sphereParam, sphereParam_norm, chartPreimage, and the Sphere and E3 abbreviations. I also grepped for uses of the lemmas. Everything in the file is tied to the unit 2-sphere in E3, its chart-based cone map, and the specific `sphereMetric`. A generalisation to other dimensions or other spheres would need new mathematics, because the cone derivative determinant, the 1/3 radial integral and `sphereMetric` are all dimension-specific. That is not a cheap generalisation.

Two small ones exist but I judged them not worthwhile. `sphereCone_injOn` only uses positivity of the radii, so `Ioo 0 1` could become any subset of `Ioi 0`. `sphereCone_image` holds for any radius set. The only uses of these lemmas are the unit-cone `Ioo 0 1` setting that `Measure.toSphere` defines, so the more general forms would add no practical benefit. I did not read the `toSphere` definition or `lintegral_join_product`. My grep of the repos root failed because it was outside the allowed directories. I found no strong, useful generalisation.
